name: Abishai
overview: Abishai, son of Zeruiah and brother to Joab, emerges in Scripture as a fierce and loyal warrior who serves as one of King David's chief men. He demonstrates boldness and courage by volunteering to confront Saul in his camp, confident that God had delivered Saul into their hands (1 Samuel 26:6-8). Alongside Joab, Abishai pursues and kills Abner to avenge their brother Asahel (2 Samuel 2:24; 3:30), and he commands troops in battles against the Ammonites, evidencing his role as a key military leader entrusted by David (2 Samuel 10:10). These accounts reveal a man devoted to David’s cause, willing to act decisively in defense of God's anointed king.
